notes: Owner-set per-node caps for ship 0.6.222 (owner, 2026-11-05): the caps are data, not constants. Row = model x job mode (txt2img / edit) x reference count 1..N; cell = one physical tier band (8 / 16 / 24 / 32, where 32 means 32 GiB and above). A host's tier is its unified memory rounded to whole GiB (fleet decimal telemetry, e.g. 34.36 GB -> 32), placed in the first band it clears; below 8 GiB no cell applies and nothing is offered. 'allowed: false' means this node may not take that work; 'max_reference_images' is the effective cap, separate from the engine's own intrinsic cap. swap_allowance_gb is decimal GB of host swap growth allowed from a job's start baseline and IS enforced in 0.6.222: a running image job whose host swap grows beyond the allowance stops with reason 'host swap grew beyond allowance' (evidence: job-start baseline vs live sample); a hard stop on macOS critical memory pressure is unconditional for every image job. source: measured (a run behind the receipt), owner limit (owner's instruction), owner: known to run (owner's own prior runs, not yet measured), provisional, measuring (owner-set while measurement runs), not measured on this tier (inherited from a smaller measured tier). Never inherit a larger tier's cap upward from a smaller measured tier. No override writer exists in 0.6.222; overrides are deferred to 0.6.223.
tier_format: physical tiers in binary GiB; fleet telemetry reports decimal GB (memory_gb), converted with round(bytes / 1024^3)
swap_allowance_units: decimal GB of host swap growth from a job's start baseline

evidence.available_metric: Hub host_memory.available_bytes; max(psutil free+inactive, free+file-backed+purgeable-kernel free target), capped by total-wired-compressor
evidence.formula: reclaimable = (free + file_backed + purgeable - margin) * page; ceiling = total - wired - compressor_bytes; available_bytes = max(0, min(max(psutil_available, reclaimable), ceiling)); tier budget = P10 nearest-rank available_gb * 1000000000 - 5000000

flux2-klein-4b-mlx-4bit.provenance: no vendor or engine contract proves a hard engine bound of 4 for FLUX.2 Klein 4-bit: mflux's flux2 edit lane exposes only MAX_REFERENCE_AREA, and the previous reference_limits value of 4 was this project's own default, not engine evidence. The owner's 222 cap of 4 at 24/32 GiB is an owner limit; the engine's intrinsic bound stays unknown until probed (a later 5-count probe must not be read as accepted - the validator stops it before execution).
